# Data

```{r data-load}
data_path <- here::here("data", "processed", "clean_data.rds")
if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
  stop("Missing ", data_path, ". Put sales_data.csv in data/raw/ and run scripts/01_clean_data.R")
}
dat <- readRDS(data_path)
```

```{r data-vars}
tibble(Variable = names(dat), Type = map_chr(dat, ~ class(.x)[1])) |>
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, caption = "Variables in the cleaned dataset") |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```
